dedupe_keys.name: structural state spectral change in vibration powered bridge monitoring power retention and sensing availability analysis code

description: Mourad Nouioua publishes MATLAB analysis code for vibration-powered bridge monitoring under structural change. Zenodo archives the MIT-licensed source, and the linked repository documents a reduced-order energy-harvester model, a power-retention fragility law, tuning-bias analysis, an energy-constrained sensing-node simulation and damage detection. It uses public bridge acceleration records from separate providers and can test whether a monitoring system remains powered while bridge modal properties shift. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code. A limitation is that the measurement datasets have separate licences and must be acquired independently; the README names MATLAB R2025a and two toolboxes as dependencies. The model’s state-change and circuit assumptions may need new calibration for another bridge. Neither source archive nor measurements were downloaded, and the tests, detector scores and reported figures were not reproduced.
